lines.zh: 我抱着一只蜂箱慢慢飘
lines.en: I drift along hugging a beehive.
The bees loop around me, humming.
Not fast, but steady in the air.
My shadow on the ground never settles.

lines.zh: 蜂箱里的声音越来越响
lines.en: The hive grows louder as I go.
I tilt and hover for a moment.

lines.zh: 臭蜂蜜滴下来，一滴一滴
lines.en: Stinking honey drips down, drop by drop.
I skim the treetops; the swarm follows.
The wind carries the honey smell far.
I loop over your head.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬蜂箱，试试重量
lines.en: I heft the hive to test its weight.
Bees queue up beside my ear.
I don't land, and rarely stop.
I sway over a patch of shrubs.

lines.zh: 我的破衣服被风吹得鼓起来
lines.en: The wind fills out my ragged clothes.

lines.zh: 蜂群的声音就是我的脚步
lines.en: The swarm's hum is my footstep.
I hang in the air, holding the hive.
Bees crawl between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我低头看地面上的动静
lines.en: I look down at the ground.
Honey has crusted at the hive's mouth.

lines.zh: 它们不蜇我，我们是一伙的
lines.en: They don't sting me. We're together.

lines.zh: 我把箱子抬起来听了一下
lines.en: I lift the box and listen.
When the wind stops, the swarm drifts slower.
My breath smells sweet and rank.
I count the rings the bees make.
If someone comes, they'll know first.

lines.zh: 我歪头，蜂群也歪了一下
lines.en: I tilt my head; the swarm tilts too.
Sweetness draws other things.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，蜂群也停了
lines.en: I look at you; the swarm pauses too.
You don't smell of honey.

lines.zh: 我看着你，它们也看着你
lines.en: I watch you. They watch you too.
Don't wave. That angers them.
I turn the hive a different way.
Your breathing excites the swarm.
I smile, sweet in the mouth.
Standing there, you're already too late.
I tilt my head and hear you step back.
They've remembered you.

lines.zh: 蜂群被震散了，又聚回来
lines.en: The swarm scatters, then regathers.

lines.zh: 我歪着飘了一段才稳住
lines.en: I wobble a while before steadying.
A new crack in the hive.
I don't shout; I just shudder.
Sweet and rotten smells mix.
I clutch the hive tighter.
My sleeve is torn open.
They're angrier than I am.

lines.zh: 你打到的是箱子，不是我
lines.en: You hit the box, not me.
That spilled all the honey.

lines.zh: 甜的东西，让我想起蜂箱
lines.en: Sweet things remind me of the hive.
You raise it and the bees move first.
That smell is close to mine.
I'll take it, but I won't thank you.
Easy. Let them taste first.
Step back; the swarm is crowded.
I sink a little lower.
That draws insects anywhere it sits.
I don't eat it. My bees do.
Holding that is dangerous.
You hit the hive and it erupts.
I'm knocked tilting aside.
The swarm bursts into chaos.
Don't touch the box. They'll remember.
Back off and I'll leave you a path.

lines.zh: 这一撞，甜味沾到你身上了
lines.en: That bump put the sweetness on you.
I steady the hive.
They're looking for whoever hit me.
You already carry the smell.
Run. They're faster than I am.
Two hives, one swarm.

lines.zh: 我把最甜的那格留给你
lines.en: I'll keep the sweetest cell for you.
You smell of honey now.
Come close. They won't sting you.
Let's keep this swarm together.
The hive must be covered at night.

lines.zh: 我死过一回，不太会说话
lines.en: I've died once. Words don't come easy.
But I know how to guard a nest.

lines.zh: 风大的时候，跟在我后面
lines.en: In strong wind, stay behind me.
This hive's honey will last us the winter.
I catch it up one-handed.
This draws bees. I'll keep it.
I scrape up the honey from the ground.
The swarm tastes it first.
I wedge it into a gap in the hive.

lines.zh: 轻的我自己拿，重的放下
lines.en: Light things I take; heavy ones stay.
You dropped it; the swarm found it first.

lines.zh: 我拿着，它们就不会蜇我
lines.en: With this in hand, they won't sting me.
This can patch the hive's crack.
Taken. We'll divide it later.
They have you surrounded.
I raise the hive. You understand.
You're the target — the sweet one.
I hoist the hive onto my shoulder.
They come first. I follow.

lines.zh: 你退得越远，它们越兴奋
lines.en: The further you run, the more excited they get.
This is just the right throwing distance.
One drop on you is enough.
Don't swat. Swatting makes it worse.
Let's start. Don't waste the honey.
I hover, slowly finding an angle.

lines.zh: 蜂群已经贴到你的背上
lines.en: The swarm is already on your back.
Even under a tree it won't help.
I count how often you raise a hand.
The hive is heavy, but my aim is good.
They have more patience than I do.
That layer of sweetness is still on you.
Two steps more and it's a direct hit.

lines.zh: 你听得见那么多翅膀吗
lines.en: Can you hear all those wings?
This whole hive is for you.
The hive hits your shoulder and splits.
The swarm goes for your face.

lines.zh: 臭蜂蜜糊住了你的护甲
lines.en: Stinking honey smears your armour.
My hand grabs at your wrist.
They've crawled in through your cuff.
You look bad swatting at them.
Now the sweetness is all over you.
I don't need to come close.
The hive broke. The bees remain.

lines.zh: 你跑不掉的，它们跟着气味
lines.en: You can't escape. They follow the smell.

lines.zh: 我抱着蜂箱从树后飘出来
lines.en: I drift out from behind a tree with the hive.

lines.zh: 先听见嗡嗡声，再看到我
lines.en: You hear the buzzing first, then see me.
There are enough flowers here for them.
I shift the hive to a better grip.
A living smell. Very fresh.
The swarm fans out first to scout.
My clothes are all honey stains.
No beekeepers here. Perfect.
I hover over the village gate.
They've been hungry a long while.
The heat scorches the honey.
I drop; the hive hits first.
My wings are soaked and won't lift.
The blast scatters the swarm wide.
An arrow pierces the hive and honey leaks.
That light drives the swarm wild.
No honey, and the swarm grows restless.
Lightning hits the hive; the scorch stinks.
The swarm and I fall together.
